notes.title: Beta 2.0.3 Hot fix 3
notes.content:
[b]Beta 2.0.3[/b]

[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added movement speed stat to stat box
[*] Added cooldown reduction stat to stat box
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Game saves progress after leveling forest
[*] Now when player dies on Hardcore game will save that he died
[*] Skeleton boss damage reduced by 17%
[*] Spider boss damage reduced by 33%
[*] Slime boss damage reduced by 17%
[*] Mad Birch boss damage reduced by 15%
[*] Load and delete button got swapped
[*] Lightning aura level 1 range changed from 2 to 1.5
[*] Lightning aura level 2 range changed from 3 to 3.75
[*] Lightning aura visuals got changed to reduce flash effect
[/list]

[b]Fix:[/b]
[list]
[*] In portal UI rewards info was showed twice
[*] Portal Upgrades. Upgrade "Increase enemies per minute" was showing % instead of flat number
[*] Portal Upgrades. All upgrades witch chance to spawn better type of enemy had wrong information
[*] Portal Upgrades. Upgrade "Chance for rare enemy" was not updating points amount
[*] Reset button in Axe auras window had no sound
[*] Reset button in Player upgrades window had no sound
[*] Boots was not scaling with "Items level" upgrade
[*] Rings level was scaling wrongly
[*] Red crystals was dropping on tier 21 instead of 20
[*] Purple crystals was dropping on tier 61 instead of 60
[*] All bosses entries was dropping on one tier higher than spouse to
[*] After killing boss now all abilities should disappear
[*] Skeleton boss animation of casting big fire ball was bad
[*] When player was running out of energy he could get negative hp
[*] Shop npc had wrong description
[*] Items in shop was showing wrong item level and price with upgrade for bigger item level
[*] Costs of items was wrong in shop
[/list]

Another hot fix for game.

notes.title: Cut The Birch Beta 1.2.0
notes.content:
[h1]Beta 1.2.0[/h1]

[h3]New:[/h3]
- Now you can see level on player stats
- Now if potion level is maxed text will be green
- Dummy is added to main base
- Max button for birch upgrades
- Max button for dungeon upgrades
- Max button for Ingots upgrades
- Now if you hover item in backpack you will see your current equipped item for easier compare
- Now you can store 25 items in chest in your base
- Some sounds effects
- Background sound
- Now game track 5 stats just for you
- Now if you have points to spend you will see "!" in corner of backpack icon
- Improved darkens effect when you ran out of time
- Day one is easier to have better start
- Now you can change cursor
- 10 new upgrades for birch
- 5 new upgrades for ingots
- 8 new upgrades for flowers

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
- Updated images in shop to mach items appearance
- Enchanting girl now will appear after defeating tier 1 on hard
- Magic girl now will appear after defeating tier 1 on medium
- Normal attack and throw attack now have new images in UI
- Hp bar of tree and enemies now will disappear on 0 hp
- Added new text for dmg if spell/attack uses all elements
- Skills speed now is caped to x5 but if you go above 5 it will start multiplying your dmg
- Improved displaying large numbers of: crit damage, ice damage, fire damage
- If damage reduction excess 90% cap then is converted to another Hp multiplier
- Bloody explosion now uses %hp instead of flat hp to cast
- Frost Field base tick time changed from 0,4s to 0,3s
- Frost Field "+20% Area, -10% time between ticks, +50% mana cost" -> "+25% Area, -5% time between ticks, +50% mana cost"
- Frost Filed "+10% Crit damage while active, +100% Mana cost" -> "10% Crit damage while active (Another multiplier), +500% Mana cost"
- Frost Field "+20% Damage, +40 Mana cost" -> "+40% Damage, +40 Mana cost"
- Fireball % ice shard "+1 Projectile, +100% Mana cost" -> "+1 Projectile, +200% Mana cost"
- Fireball % ice shard "+25% damage, +40% Mana cost" -> "+40% damage, +80% Mana cost"
- Fireball % ice shard "-10% cool down, +20% Mana cost" -> "-5% cool down, +20% Mana cost"
- Fire Swing "-2 Mana cost" -> "5% chance to trigger crit multiplier second time, +500% Mana cost"
- Fire Swing "+10% damage, +20% Mana cost" -> "+40% damage, +40% Mana cost"
- Ice buff to axe, mana cost now scales with ice damage
- Fire buff to axe, mana cost now scales with fire damage
- Fire ball mana cost now scales with fire damage
- Ice shard mana cost now scales with ice damage
- Frost Field mana cost now scales with ice damage
- Fire Slash mana cost now scales with fire damage
- Elite drop chance for item changed from 10% -> 15%
- Elite drop chance for necklace changed from 20% -> 40% (First you need to hit 15% chance for drop then you have 60% chance for ring and 40% for necklace)
- Game now remember your last tier on all difficulties separably
- Changed portal GUI 
- Enchanting range changed from 1-10% -> 2-5%
- Removed another +5% to item stats on every 5th upgrade
- Changed backpack GUI

[h3]Fix:[/h3]
- Interaction Obj now shows when you are close to portal
- In potions GUI arrow for upgrade was showing even when potion had max level
- If enemy had to much hp game was crashing due to hp bar bug

notes.title: Cut The Birch Update
notes.content:
[h1]Beta 1.1.0[/h1]

[h2]New:[/h2]
- Number which shows how much trees left to cut
- Improved fire slash textures
- Now minions in dungeons despawn after killing boss
- Now minions in dungeons can't spawn on player
- Max button for item enchanting and upgrading
- Items on sell now give some iron and crystals if they was upgraded
- New item info in shop, now you can see more info about them
- Portal now remember last difficulty
- New portal GUI for entering forest
- Forest Tiers now scales infinitely
- After finishing boss in dungeon gold portal will spawn and if you will have enough crystals after using it you will be send to dungeon again!

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
- Items stats range got changed
- Gems stats range got changed
- "Iron Blood" upgrade from portal. Now can't be turned off
- "Flower Nightmare" upgrade from portal. Now can't be turned off
- xp need for level now spikes by x10 every 100 levels instead of x(100 * (player level / 500))
Example for xp before and after base value for this will be 100 xp
Before:
[list]
[*] Level 1: 100xp
[*] 	Level 500: 100'000xp
[*] 	Level 1000: 200'000xp
[*] 	Level 1500: 300'000xp
[/list]
After:
[list]
[*] Level 1: 100xp
[*] 	Level 100: 1'000xp
[*] 	Level 200: 10'000xp
[*] 	Level 300: 100'000xp
[*] 	Level 500: 10'000'000xp
[*] 	Level 1000: 1'000'000'000'000xp
[*] 	Level 1500: 100'000'000'000'000'000xp
[/list]
- Eternal tree now give x3 portal xp
- Elites in forest now drop portal xp
- Now you can see max level of an item
- Snakes now attack much faster
- Unlocking items in shop got changed
- Slowed down Forest Blessing to save some fps

[h2]Fix:[/h2]
- Typos
- Mana gem was bugged
- Fire gem was bugged
- Movement speed upgrade in skill tree was bugged
- After dying in dungeon backpack, forest upgrades buttons was vanishing
- Portal animation was glitching after going to dungeon
- After restarting player stats tree images to not update correctly
- Potions layout was off by a little
- Hp and mp regen stats was showing negative numbers if they are to big
- UI of enchanter and Gem tree was not close correctly with an "Esc" key
- If hp/mp regen was to high it was killing you instead of heeling you
- Max level of few potions was wrong
- In item upgrader when player was upgrading items tier V it was showing wrong img of crystals
- Minions in dungeons had base hp instead of scaled to difficulty
- Crit dmg values was showed wrongly on dmg text
- Fixed physics of objects to increase fps in late game
- Dmg reduction and movement speed was showing wrong stats in backpack if item was upgraded

[h2]Items stats scaling change[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077712/bf1f34e85bc9a24733bfa9d227b8bccb8b74cfe0.png[/img]

[h2]Gems stats scaling change[/h2]
